name: Maastricht University Ransomware
desc: In 2019, the Maastricht University was targeted by a ransomware attack. At least 267 internal servers were affected in this incident.

acts.d: Malicious Microsoft Excel file is attached in a phishing campaign
A malware is downloaded through Excel Macros and executed into the victim's server

acts.n: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
acts.d: Malware registers itself as an autostart application on boot in Windows system registry
The malware communicates with C2 server over TCP every 15 minutes

acts.n: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
acts.d: An interactive shell is deployed by another malware included in SDBBot
Attacker spreads Meterpreter malware to different internal servers through an unpatched vulnerability
Attacker discovers internal Active Directory hosts in the domain
Attacker checks for vulnerable hosts within the domain
Attacker gains access to local SYSTEM account through a vulnerability
Attacker retrieves the login credential stored in memory from a recent login activity
Attacker has execution access on the machine
Attackers discovers all active servers in the domain
Attacker creates an overview of the entire domain by scanning for services running on the servers within the victim's network
Attacker creates an overview of the entire domain by scanning for processes running on the servers within the victim's network
Using domain administrator privileges, the attacker places malicious software on internal servers as a preparation for deploying a ransomware attack.

acts.n: Impair Defense: Disable or Modify Tools
acts.d: Using local administrator account, attacker disables and uninstalls McAfee antivirus from the server

acts.n: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
acts.d: Using local administrator account, attacker disables Microsoft Defender from the server
Attacker launches ransomware attack on all infected servers in the UNIMAAS domain.
